Attachments: ClearCart_POC_KPIs.pdf, short-quote-guidelines.docx (stubs)

Alex / Priya — really appreciate the great work with the POC last week. Quick recap from our side (attached PDF has the full table):

- Mean generation latency down ~30% (from 420ms -> 290ms)
- Average cost per API call reduced ~42% after batching + KV caching
- Throughput improvement: sustained 3x higher requests/second at peak test loads
- Concurrency headroom: handled 2.5x concurrent sessions without errors

We'd love to include ClearCart as a short customer reference. Two asks:
1) A 1–2 line blurb we can use (one sentence, optional attribution like Alex Chen, Head of ML). I added a couple of examples in the attached "short-quote-guidelines.docx" to make it quick.
2) A quick 10‑minute call this week to read the quote out loud and sign permission for publishing.

If it's easier, here are two suggested one-liners you can pick from and edit:
- "Redwood cut our inference latency by ~30% while lowering per-call costs by ~40%, letting us scale features faster."
- "With Redwood we achieved 3x throughput gains and significant cost savings in production POCs."

Proposed times (PST): Wed 11/3 10:00am, Thu 11/4 2:00pm, Fri 11/5 9:30am. If none work, tell me your availability and we'll adapt.

Thanks again — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
